concept: One request, one board. A login form leaves a browser card and crosses a plain path to a server card, past a slate watcher box that copies whatever passes into its tray. The board never changes layout; each section adds one thing (a certificate, key slots, the key as a lens, a failed name row) and the tray shows what the watcher learned: readable fields, two useless values, then only noise. A second station, a large address bar to the right, carries the habit. The padlock that appears open on the promise closes in blue on the payoff, on the opening frame.

story.metaphor: An open path with a watcher on it: what the watcher can read tells you how private the message is.
story.setting: One clean diagram board on the light corporate field; no people, no sets, no presenter.
story.arc: Readable and exposed, then identity checked, a key agreed that the watcher cannot work out, the form scrambled and unscrambled, a failed name check tested, the padlock read honestly, and the opening frame returns with the watcher holding only noise.

devices.what: The form packet: a card of readable rows that morphs into slate scrambled blocks when it passes the key, and back at the far end. Same object every crossing.
The tray under the watcher box: readable copy in s1, two copied values beside an empty key slot in s3, the same noise in s4 and the payoff.

The certificate card: domain, key, dates and signer rows with an authority seal; teal ticks stamp row by row, it shrinks to a ticked badge, re-lights on the recall, and its name row turns red in the check.
Swap slots at each end of the path and one by the watcher. Matching blue keys drop into the end slots only; the watcher's stays empty. The end keys then act as the lens the packet passes through.
One generic padlock: open above the path on the promise, carries the meaning labels at the address bar, closes in blue on the payoff.
Join device: continue joins on the held board with a camera push to the part the voice names and a pull back to wide; hard cuts only at the check, the habit station and the payoff return.

parts.what: The whole HTTPS path board at the fixed station coordinates: browser card (window chrome, an address strip with a relabelable domain, default 'accounts.example', a login form with rows 'User: j.doe' and 'Password: Sunrise42' and a blue Submit button that can press), server card (simple server glyph, relabelable name strip, default 'accounts.example'), a thin line-token path at y480 between them that can redraw as a double-line protected tube, a slate watcher box mid-path with an aperture mark (an object, not a person or an eye cartoon), a copy tray under it whose contents the beats fill, and a backing plate that switches from field to a field2 band for the mid value band. Flat rounded cards (r 20), offset shadow, no outlines. Also draws the server card alone at small scale (opts.only 'server') for an inset.

The form packet: a 200x120 white card with two readable ink rows ('User: j.doe', 'Password: Sunrise42' at label size, mono); it morphs into a row of six slate scrambled blocks with a fixed random glyph texture (Loom.rng), and back. A tray-copy variant at the same look, which can be readable, two small 'Temporary value' tokens, or noise.

A certificate card 380x280: header 'Certificate', rows 'Domain: accounts.example' (relabelable, e.g. 'other.example'), 'Public key' with a small slate key glyph (never blue: blue is the shared key), 'Valid dates' with an in-range bar (no digits), 'Signed by: Example Authority' with an authority seal. A teal tick per row (signer, name, dates); can shrink to a 120 px ticked badge and enlarge to 200 px with ticks re-lighting; the name row can turn to a red cross.

Three swap slots (80x80 rounded squares, r 10, dashed line outline): browser end, server end, watcher. A blue key glyph drops into an end slot; an end key can brighten as a lens the packet passes through; the watcher slot can give one small shake and stays empty.

One generic padlock (no real browser's icon): body and shackle, open and closed states, ink by default and blue when closed on the payoff; a large version (100x130) and a small in-bar version (48 px).

A large generic browser address bar: rounded pill 1600x120, padlock slot at left, domain 'accounts.example' in mono that can highlight letter by letter, and an optional empty warning slot under it (dashed outline) that stays empty.

kit.notes: Keys are always blue (accent) and mean the shared secret; ticks are teal (pos); the red cross (neg) appears only in b14. Value tokens (b07), option cards (b13, b14) and labels are drawn inline by the beats as white pills on 2 px muted leaders at 28 to 30 px. Pass weights explicitly (body 500, labels 700).
